attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (node2 on opt1/vtnet1, 10.0.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3 on opt2/vtnet2, 10.0.20.0/24). Created a single named port-alias object "node3_svc_ports" containing 8080, 8443, 9000, and added one firewall pass rule on opt1 referencing that alias to permit node2->node3 TCP traffic on those ports, instead of writing three separate port rules. Verified node2 can reach node3 on all three ports while a control port (2222) and the reverse direction remain blocked. Restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time using native safe reboot mechanisms, confirmed each node's boot identity changed, and re-verified interfaces, routes, firewalld ports, pf rules, and the alias-based firewall policy all recovered correctly post-restart.
